phaseHistory.name: PR Cleanup
phaseHistory.note: Resumed from the needs-manual-rebase hold. Rebased twice onto origin/main (8280202, then c9c7364), resolved five conflicting files, re-measured both prompt-margin pins and re-tuned the over-budget window fixture empirically.

phaseHistory.name: Wrapup and Merge
phaseHistory.note: PR #291 squash-merged to main as 24218ca at 2026-09-04T23:03:12Z, with the trial-merge gate clean (rc=0) against origin/main c9c7364 immediately before it.

conflictsResolved.strategy: manual, per an explicit product decision. The user chose option 1 of the two the blocker recorded: shorten REQ-617's own prompt addition rather than raise REDACT_BODY_OVERHEAD_BYTES and re-derive the redact constants. redact.rs: both ledger paragraphs kept (REQ-615's and REQ-617's), REQ-615's structural work (LOCAL_ENGINE_N_CTX_DEFAULT, the const fns) taken whole, and the guide's command roster cut by 197 bytes -- 29 names collapsed to 17 families with `teton_docs commands` carrying sub-commands and effects, BR-3's ending stripped of the parenthetical that re-listed five switches the roster already names, /help /cd /transcript /context kept spelled out. Both recorded margin pins then re-measured from the failing assert_eq!, not reasoned: 455 -> 112 and 502 -> 159, gap still 47. skill_over_budget_offer.rs: the Window/FitsWindow window re-tuned empirically by sweeping it, 31,000 -> 32,000 (REQ-615's re-centred 50,600 body kept). events.rs: append-only on both sides, both kept. session_ui.rs and turn_loop.rs: import lists unioned.
conflictsResolved.verifiedHow: cargo test -p tetond --lib the_total_cap_clears_the_harness_context_budget_with_margin and the_web_tool_docs_clear_the_outbound_body_overhead both green at the re-measured pins with the RECORDED_MARGIN_GAP_BYTES const-assert holding; the whole skill_over_budget_offer suite green (15/15) with the band's edges probed either side (29,600 fails ExceedsWindow, 150,000 fails no-offer); then cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
conflictsResolved.note: Rebase onto origin/main at 8280202, which carried REQ-615 (#289), REQ-616 (#290) and REQ-618 (#292) -- two more than the blocker was recorded against. The blocker's own arithmetic (818 bytes against 733, needing ~133 of relief) was derived; the measured deficit at the rebased tip was 85 bytes over the ceiling, and the 197-byte cut leaves 112 of margin against the 48-byte floor.

notes: Phase 7 halted at 2026-09-04T21:22Z per BUG-207: the trial merge against origin/main returned rc=1 and adlc_conflict_append_only named two modified-line offenders (redact.rs, skill_over_budget_offer.rs), so the bounded keep-both path did not apply. Nothing was resolved and nothing was pushed.

Resumed 2026-09-04T22:30Z on an explicit product decision from the user: option 1 of the two the blocker recorded -- shorten REQ-617's own prompt addition, do NOT raise REDACT_BODY_OVERHEAD_BYTES and do NOT re-derive the redact constants. See conflictsResolved for what was done and how it was verified.

The rebase base moved twice while the resume ran: origin/main was 8280202 (REQ-615, REQ-616, REQ-618) at the first rebase and c9c7364 (REQ-618's wrapup) at the second. Two more REQs than the blocker was recorded against, which is why the blocker's DERIVED 133-byte relief figure was wrong: the measured deficit at the rebased tip was 85 bytes over the ceiling.

Two CI failures on the rebased tip, both real signal, neither caused by the resolution. (1) `a_failed_command_comes_back_raw_with_no_interpretation` pinned `(exit 1)` and `No such file or directory` -- a failed `cd` exits 1 under bash (macOS's /bin/sh) and 2 under dash (Ubuntu's). The test asserted which shell the runner ships; fixed to parse the `(exit N)` marker and assert non-zero, and to match the `[stderr]` line on the builtin and the path. AC-7's wording corrected in the requirement. This defect was in the branch before the rebase and had never been seen: CI could not compute checks for a PR whose merge commit was unresolvable, so the tip was never built until now. (2) `attach_authorization::a_client_that_attached_through_the_grant_flow_receives_that_sessions_events` failed once on the Linux leg, seeing both context_cleared envelopes where one was its to see; it passed on a same-commit re-run and 15/15 locally. A pre-existing latent race in a file REQ-617 does not touch -- LESSON-450's class. Recorded, not chased.

Final verification on the merged tip: cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast green at 4,446 passed / 0 failed, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings clean, cargo fmt --all --check clean, and cargo test -p tetond --test e2e green at 67 passed after rebuilding the binaries.

AC-1 (b) and AC-8 (b) remain deferred-to-a-machine-with-weights, as the validation pass recorded: both need the `llama` feature and several GB of downloaded model weights, neither of which exists in this pipeline or in CI.
